title: I'm From London
description: Dense mixed-media collage incorporating an American football, chess piece, archery target, warplane silhouette, compact discs, and football goalposts across a vivid layered ground. Text reading 'I'M FROM LONDON' runs along the lower edge alongside Arsenal club badges and the word 'BUCKEYES' in the upper right.
composition: wall-to-wall layered elements, text bottom edge
